tools.name: timedoctor_whoami
tools.description: Show the connected Time Doctor user, their role and the companies this token can reach, with company ids. Call this first to get company ids. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/authorization.

tools.name: timedoctor_list_company_timezones
tools.description: List the distinct IANA timezones used by the company's users. Use it to pick a reporting timezone. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/companies/{companyId}/timezones.

tools.name: timedoctor_list_users
tools.description: List the company's users with their ids, names, roles and group assignments. Filter by group, manager or name. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/users.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by id: profile, role and settings. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/users/{id}.

tools.name: timedoctor_list_groups
tools.description: List the company's groups (Time Doctor calls them tags), with their ids. Use the ids as `tag` in other tools. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/tags.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_group
tools.description: Get one group (tag) by id, with its settings. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/tags/{id}.

tools.name: timedoctor_list_projects
tools.description: List the company's projects with their ids. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/projects.

tools.name: timedoctor_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks, optionally only those in some projects. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/tasks.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/tasks/{id}.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_worklog
tools.description: Get the tracked activity intervals (the timeline) for users in a time range. Dates: a plain yyyy-mm-dd `from` is the start of that UTC day and `to` includes that whole day. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/activity/worklog.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_time_summary
tools.description: Get totals of tracked time, idle time and related counts for users or groups in a range. Dates: a plain yyyy-mm-dd `from` is the start of that UTC day and `to` includes that whole day. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.1/stats/total.

tools.name: timedoctor_get_productivity_breakdown
tools.description: Get tracked time per productivity category (productive, unproductive, neutral, unrated) for users or groups in a range. Dates: a plain yyyy-mm-dd `from` is the start of that UTC day and `to` includes that whole day. Time Doctor's plan rules apply. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.1/stats/category.

tools.name: timedoctor_list_work_schedules
tools.description: List scheduled shifts and leave for users in a range, with approval state. Dates: a plain yyyy-mm-dd `from` is the start of that UTC day and `to` includes that whole day. Time Doctor API: GET /api/1.0/work-schedules.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "timedoctor_whoami" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
